summary: Iteration 3 (content + layout + mobile fixes) fully verified. Backend 5/5 pytest pass. Frontend: Personas has 4 service cards with fuller bullets (beaker includes 'Fluidos biológicos y estudios especiales'; molecule includes 'Paneles específicos'). Empresas has 3 service cards; hero contains 'Ver menú de estudios' linking to /assets/menus/menu-es.pdf and NO WhatsApp button in hero; 'Contactanos' still links to /contacto; toggling language flips the href to menu-en.pdf. Nosotros renders sections in the correct order: history + quote, 'Nuestra experiencia' (4 cards with +40 / +20 / 1er / -180°C), 'Hitos e innovación' (4 milestone cards), 'Dirección científica' with exactly 2 EQUAL-SIZED team cards (415x519 each), values, Stats, Gallery (with tabs+lightbox), Partners and Instagram CTA. Language toggle switches all new sections (Our experience, Milestones & innovation, Scientific direction) and persists via localStorage horvath_lang. Mobile (390x844): no horizontal overflow on Home/Personas/Empresas/Nosotros (scrollWidth==390), .scroll-cue hidden, header phone icon-link hidden, page-hero-actions buttons stretch full-width (342px each within 390px viewport). Contact form still POSTs to /api/leads and shows data-testid=form-success. PDFs return HTTP 200 (menu-es.pdf ~33MB, menu-en.pdf ~33MB).
critical_code_review_comments: MENU PDFs are ~33MB each — consider CDN hosting or compression before public launch.
Nosotros.jsx: team-photo uses object-position: center 18% which is a compromise across both photos; if either headshot changes it may need tweaking.
server.py /api/leads still has no pagination/rate-limiting — pre-existing note from iteration_2.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_-prefixed lead created via UI (TEST_Iter3, whatsapp). No delete endpoint; not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter3 acceptance criteria pass: fuller service bullets (Personas 4, Empresas 3), Empresas hero uses MENU_PDF[lang] with IconFileText (no WhatsApp in hero, /contacto retained), Nosotros has 4 exp cards + 4 milestones + 2 equal team photos + gallery, EN toggle flips all new content, localStorage persists 'horvath_lang', mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow and hero buttons stretch full-width with scroll-cue hidden. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_horvath_api.py 5/5.
